scripts.test: pnpm --filter @bakimos/api-contracts build && pnpm --filter @bakimos/api test && pnpm --filter @bakimos/web test
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @bakimos/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @bakimos/api exec prisma db seed
scripts.postinstall: pnpm --filter @bakimos/api-contracts build && DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://bakimos:bakimos@127.0.0.1:5432/bakimos} pnpm --filter @bakimos/api exec prisma generate
